context.title: Council of Community Housing Organizations: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: Council of Community Housing Organizations signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Contributions to the Housing Fund)

positions.statement: Council of Community Housing Organizations signed the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition C in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Council of Community Housing Organizations signed the paid argument against San Francisco Proposition D in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Council of Community Housing Coalitions and Council of Community Housing Organizations signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I and the rebuttal to the argument against San Francisco Proposition I and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition I in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
